column2: Nth of CountersPut over one kind of counter ("charge counters ... for the first time each turn"): the turn ordinal of Happened::Counters (Tally::Countered) counts the counters of every kind, so the validator allows Nth only over CountersPut of any kind

If you can't, exile up to one target creature. after the chosen assimilate: a performed binding for Choose+R116Assimilate (Effect::R116Assimilate is Reports::Nothing in resolve/prim/done.rs) and the reader/writer for "If you can't"
+1: Add one mana of any color. When you spend this mana to cast an Aura spell this turn, create ... and "−3: ... For each Aura attached to you, attach it to an opponent of your choice."
the next artifact creature spell and the next Spacecraft spell you cast this turn have undaunted

Each opponent reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a creature card. Assimilate one of the creature cards revealed this way. Then each opponent puts the other cards ...: reveal-until per opponent, a Choose among the revealed creature cards, then R116Assimilate
stations Spacecraft and crews Vehicles as though his power were tripled
chapter III "Exile the Borg assimilated with this Saga, then return it ...": a memory of what the Saga assimilated (R116Assimilate does not remember into the source's slot)

clone "except it isn't legendary and it has \"This creature's power and toughness are each equal to ...\"": a granted characteristic-defining ability in the copy exception (CopyExcept with GrantAbility of a defining Static)

You may cast any number of spells with mana value less than or equal to <count> from among those cards without paying their mana costs: RepeatEach over the exiled cards with a ManaValue filter whose amount is fixed as the ability resolves (the count may change as Officers are cast), and its writer "from among those cards"

Destination::Battlefield counters are fixed numbers: "X additional +1/+1 counters if it's a creature and X additional charge counters if it's a Spacecraft" needs counted counters on a Move by the type of the moved card
granted beam me up to graveyard cards during your main phase with cost equal to the mana cost and the self-exclusion
Copy that card X times ... You may cast the copies without paying their mana costs. Exile ~.: copies of a card in exile cast for free

TriggerPattern for any random action of a player, once per action: a discard at random (ChosenAtRandom from a hand is not told apart from a pick of a public zone), random targets (Targetable::AtRandom logs no event of its own), random modes (Modal at_random), a coin flip and a die roll (CoinFlipped/DieRolled grouped by instruction)

AsCopy counters equal to the same number and kinds of counters the copied permanent has (CopyCounters of every kind of the copied object, `counters: [{of: copied}]`), and a writer for "except it isn't legendary" on an artifact-or-creature copy
Trigger on casting a spell or activating a non-mana ability with {X} in its cost, with an effect that sets the announced X to 5 (a replacement of the X announcement, CR 601.2b), once each turn

A named Equipment token with its own equip cost and a granted static ("with \"Equipped creature gets +1/+1\" and equip {2}"), Attach to the source; "Each Equipment token you control becomes a copy of target Equipment you control until end of turn" (BecomeCopy over Each)

ReplaceBy for "enters tapped and attacking" on an Enters replacement of creatures you control, with the condition "while you control an attacking creature", and the attack target chosen as it enters (CR 508.4)
Pred "that you've put a counter on this turn" (a turn log of counters put by a player, per permanent, TallyEvent CountersPut with by)
Granting a trigger to the entering creature that copies the card exiled by this ability and casts the copy free (linked exile carried into a granted ability)

A trigger on a source you control dealing damage "if at least one permanent or player was dealt exactly 2 of that damage" (a batch DealsDamage with a per-recipient amount filter), then exile the top card with play until the end of your next turn

A spell whose targets depend on whether it was kicked (target creature an opponent controls unkicked, target opponent kicked, CR 601.2c) and a CopyOf token for each creature that player controls, except it has menace

Delayed trigger on a player losing the game (no TriggerPattern reads Event::PlayerLost) with snapshots of the artifacts and creatures that player controlled as they lost, copied as tokens after the player's objects left (CR 800.4a), under "for as long as they have a contract counter"

A conditional activated effect "If ~ is a Rogue, he becomes a Ferengi Scout with base power and toughness 3/4 and gains a quoted trigger" (Continuous SetCreatureTypes + SetPT + GrantAbility under If Matches This), and the second form granting two rules (play lands from graveyard, an additional land)

An optional replacement of a draw by a choice of land or nonland and a RevealUntil of that kind, the card to hand and the rest to the bottom at random (ReplaceWhen Draw by MayInstead with ChooseWords feeding the RevealUntil filter)
Granting an activated ability to a card in exile ("Exile a card from your hand: Create a copy of this card. You may cast the copy. Activate only during your turn and only if this card is exiled.")

Eminence: a triggered ability that works from the command zone as well as the battlefield (Triggered from takes one zone), and a trigger on exactly 1 damage to you or exactly 1 life lost caused by your sources, with a second-resolution rider
A named legendary Aura Curse token created attached to a target player, with enchant player and a life-loss doubling replacement for the enchanted player

A delayed trigger returning the creature sacrificed for the activation's cost (Ref::Paid read by a DelayedTrigger made by the resolution: the card in the graveyard the sacrificed permanent became, CR 400.7)
TriggerPattern for cards exiled from an opponent's library by a spell or ability you control (batch), with play permission until the end of your next turn and mana of any type

A static over creature spells you control and creature cards you own in every zone but the battlefield and the stack (AnyOf In zones, Stack spells), and "as long as it's not attacking or blocking" on each other creature
Per-opponent choice of a creature card in that player's graveyard put there from their library this turn (zone history of the card) onto the battlefield under your control

a creature that fought this way: a fight binding set only when the fight happened (May then Fight reports the yes, not whether both targets were still legal), read by a turn-long DelayedTrigger on those creatures dying
Sacrifice him unless you sacrifice three creatures, pay 3 life, and have target opponent draw three cards: an unless-cost whose part is an effect on a target opponent (draw as a cost part)

Face-down exile by another player who alone may look at the card (ExileHidden held shows the card to the effect's controller, not to the exiler), with a play permission for the player who exiled each card for as long as it remains exiled, mana of any type

Assist (CR 702.132): another player chosen as the spell is cast pays part of its generic mana (a PayMana decision for a player who is not casting, with its web support), granted to the first spell of each of your turns, and a SpellCast trigger "if another player spent mana to cast it" naming that player
Look at target opponent's hand, exile a nonland card from it; its owner may play it as long as it stays exiled at {2} more (MayCast for the owner with a cost increase linked to the exiled card)
